Start and stop work. The colour picker reaches every colour. Dragging stops getting stuck.

## 🐞 Fixed

- **Stop, then start, and it downloads again.** This is the one that has been reported four times, and the cause was never where the previous fixes were. Stopping did two things at once: it stopped the transfers AND it stopped the queue. Starting undid only the second, because the stopped transfers had been taken out of the wait queue and nothing was left that would ever hand them to a downloader again. Measured on a live instance beforehand: press start, the queue reports itself running, and four seconds later it is still nineteen stopped rows and nothing moving. A stopped transfer now waits in the queue instead of leaving it, so one press starts everything again, from the byte it stopped at.
- **A restart no longer leaves everything unstartable.** With "resume on start" set to never, every waiting download was taken out of the queue on boot while the queue itself came up reported as running. Nothing was running, nothing could run, and the switch said everything was fine. The rows now wait and the queue comes up stopped, which is the same promise stated honestly and takes one press to undo.
- **A download you paused yourself stays paused** through all of that. That is a decision about one row, and the queue's own switch has no business undoing it.
- **The colour picker reaches every colour.** Only near-white and near-black were selectable, and it stuttered. Both had the same root: the drag was reading its position from whichever square of the grid was under the finger rather than from the field, so saturation never left the first few per cent. The stutter was the grid rebuilding all 225 squares on every frame; it now rebuilds only when the hue changes.
- **Dragging to reorder stops getting stuck.** The lifted row could stay lying over the others, after which nothing could be moved at all. Two handlers race to end one gesture and neither platform promises which wins; ending is now safe to happen twice, and a fresh touch clears up after a drag that never ended.
- **The theme and corner selectors follow the rainbow.** Every card and switch around them had gone plural while those two stayed flat gold. Each segment now takes its own palette colour, with its label's ink computed against the colour it actually landed on.

## 🎨 Changed

- **The three buttons on the connection screen are one shape.** They were three: one at a fixed height on the plain surface, one accent-filled, one with a drawn outline. Same size, same spacing, same colour now, and no outline, since surfaces here are told apart by shade rather than by a line.
- GlimStone **1.6.0**, which is now a published release rather than a tag with nothing behind it. A version number is a promise that something with that name exists to read.

Settings live under **Overview › the gear › Appearance**.
